message.description: What to say out loud (it is spoken via TTS).

target.description: Where to play. Leave as '*' (default) to reach all connected pucks — use this unless the user explicitly names a specific room. A bare room name targets one puck; '@group' a configured group. Do NOT invent room names and do NOT prefix with 'freeecho2:'. Unknown/disconnected rooms are rejected.

audio_type.description: 'notification' = gentle chime (info, default); 'alarm' = urgent chime + LED (stranger, intrusion, time-critical).
